chapterInfo.content:
2
Anigyeɛ ne adwuma yɛ adehuhuo
1Mekaa no m’akomam sɛ: Bra na memfa anigyeɛ mensɔ wo nhwɛ; gye w’ani! Na hwɛ, ɛno nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ. 2Mekaa wɔ ɔsereɛ ho sɛ: Ɛyɛ adammɔ! Na mekaa wɔ anigyeɛ ho sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na wɔnya firii mu? 3#Mmb 31.4 Mepeepee m’akomam sɛ mede nsa bɛsɛpɛ me ho, na masɔ nkwaseasɛm mu ɛberɛ a mese meremma nyansa akyerɛ me kwan no. Na merepɛ ahunu sɛ ɛyɛ ma adasamma sɛ wɔbɛyɛ saa wɔ ɔsoro aseɛ, wɔn nkwa nna a ɛyɛ tia no mu. 4Meyeyɛɛ nnwuma akɛseɛ, mesisii adan, meyɛɛ bobe turo ahodoɔ fae, 5meyɛɛ turo ahodoɔ ne baabi a yɛtu mpasa a masiesie hɔ, na metetɛɛ mu nnua a ɛso aba ahodoɔ nyinaa bi; 6meyeyɛɛ nsuo atadeɛ, na mede mu nsuo magugu kwaeɛ a nnua fefɛ wɔ mu no so; 7menyaa nkoa ne mfenaa, na efie nnipa nso wɔ me, nso menyaa anantwie, nnwan ne mmirekyie akuakuo pii sene wɔn a wɔdii m’anim Yerusalem nyinaa; 8nso meboaa dwetɛ, sika, ahemfo ne nsase so ademudeɛ ano mefae, menyaa mmarima ne mmaa nnwontofoɔ ne mmarima anigyedeɛ ne mpenafoɔ bebree; 9#1 Ah 10.23 na meyɛɛ kɛse mekɔɔ so mesenee wɔn a wɔdii m’anim Yerusalem nyinaa, na me nyansa nso tenaa me mu; 10na biribiara a m’ani hwehwɛeɛ no, mankame no; mansi m’akoma anigyeɛ biara ho kwan, na m’akoma ani gyee me brɛ no nyinaa mu na yei yɛɛ me brɛ no nyinaa mu kyɛfa. 11#Ɔsɛ 1.14 Ɛnna medanee m’ani mehwɛɛ me nnwuma a me nsa yɛeɛ no nyinaa ne me brɛ a mebrɛ meyɛeɛ no, na hwɛ, ne nyinaa yɛ ahuhudeɛ ne dadwene hunu, na mfasoɔ biara nni mu owia yi ase.
12 # Ɔsɛ 1.17 Na medanee m’ani sɛ merehwɛ nyansa ne adammɔ ne nkwaseasɛm, na ɛdeɛn na onipa a ɔbɛba ɔhene akyire no bɛyɛ? Deɛ wɔayɛ no tete nteredee no ara. 13Na mehunuu sɛ mfasoɔ wɔ nyansa mu sene nkwaseasɛm mu, sɛdeɛ hann mfasoɔ sene esum deɛ no.
14 # Mmb 17.24 Onipa nyansafoɔ nim faako a ɔrekorɔ, na ɔkwasea deɛ, esum mu na ɔnanteɛ. Nanso mehunuu nso sɛ asiane korɔ no ara na ɛsiane wɔn nyinaa. 15Na mekaa no m’akomam sɛ: Ɔkwasea asiane no ara bi na ɛbɛsiane me nso; na ɛno deɛ, adɛn nti na mehunuu nyansa mesenee ebinom? Na mesee no m’akomam sɛ: Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ. 16#Dwom 49.10 Na onyansafoɔ ne ɔkwasea nyinaa, wɔrenkae wɔn daa, ɛfiri sɛ nna a ɛbɛba no mu no na werɛ afiri ne nyinaa dada; na ɛyɛ dɛn na onyansafoɔ ne ɔkwasea nyinaa wuwuo! 17Ɛnna asetena fonoo me, ɛfiri sɛ na nnoɔma a wɔyɛ no owia yi ase no nyɛ wɔ m’ani so; na ne nyinaa yɛ ahuhudeɛ ne dadwene hunu.
18 # Ɔsɛ 2.21, 26; Dwom 39.6 Na me brɛ a mebrɛɛ no owia yi ase no nyinaa fonoo me, sɛ merebɛgya no hɔ mama onipa a ɔbɛdi m’adeɛ no. 19Na hwan na ɔnim sɛ ɔbɛyɛ onyansafoɔ anaa ɔkwasea? Nanso ɔbɛdi m’adeɛ a mebrɛɛ ho mede nyansa menyaa no owia yi ase no nyinaa so. Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ.
20Na menuu me ho wɔ ɔbrɛ a mebrɛɛ owia yi ase no nyinaa ho. 21Ɛfiri sɛ ɛtɔ da a, ɛsɛ sɛ obi a ɔde ne nyansa, n’adwene ne ne nimdeɛ abrɛ ayɛ adwuma no, ɔgya ne nyinaa hɔ ma deɛ wammrɛ bɛfa: Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ ne adebɔne kɛseɛ. 22Na ɛdeɛn na onipa nya wɔ ne brɛ nyinaa ne n’akoma mu dadwene a ɔde ha ne ho owia yi ase no mu? 23Na ne nna nyinaa yɛ ayayadeɛ, na ne haw yɛ no awerɛhoɔ, nso anadwo mpo n’akoma ntɔ ne yam: Yei nso, ahuhudeɛ ne no.
24 # Ɔsɛ 3.12, 22; 5.18; 8.15; 9.7 Biribi pa biara nna hɔ mma onipa sene sɛ ɔbɛdidi na wanom na wama ne kra ahunu adepa ne brɛ no mu; yei nso mahunu sɛ Nyankopɔn nsam na ɛfire; 25ɛnyɛ ɔno a, hwan na anka ɔbɛtumi adidie anaa hwan na anka ɔbɛtumi anya anigyeɛ? 26#Mmb 13.22; 28.8 Na onipa a ɔyɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn anim no, ɔma no nyansa ne nimdeɛ ne anigyeɛ, na ɔdebɔneyɛni deɛ, ɔma no ha ne ho tase adeɛ boa ano de ma deɛ ɔyɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn anim: Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ ne dadwene hunu.

Ɛnna asetena fonoo me, ɛfiri sɛ na nnoɔma a wɔyɛ no owia yi ase no nyɛ wɔ m’ani so; na ne nyinaa yɛ ahuhudeɛ ne dadwene hunu.

Na ne nna nyinaa yɛ ayayadeɛ, na ne haw yɛ no awerɛhoɔ, nso anadwo mpo n’akoma ntɔ ne yam: Yei nso, ahuhudeɛ ne no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
